lines.t: Satsang with Mooji
© transcript Emily Beynon
Dust on my forehead
Stones beneath my knees
I come undone
Before your ancient mercy seat
My heart awaked
My spirit pierced and veiled
All darkness revealed as my failings are unveiled
Conviction brings revelation
The letters say true repentance is found
In tasting the salt of my tears
Each breath a longing, every silence filled with fear
Yet you gather those willing, drawing near
Drawing near
On the day when you call me near
Let tears be my offering, brokenness my song
Your blood, sprinkled on the nations, washes me clear
On this day of atonement, to you I belong
The Lamb without spot
The blood poured out for all
Deliverer of those once blind
Restorer of the fall
The curtain is torn, the way is made clear
The sacrifice perfect, let the humble draw near
Not by the hands of bulls or goats, nor rituals old
But brokenness lifted and courage made bold
The penalty abolished by sorrow and trust
In the shadow of the cross all pride turned to dust
Just let every weight bow heavy, tears of repentance flow
A beautiful offering my heart laid low
You are not condemned, the letters remind
All have been purchased, a new fate, a sign
On the day when you call me near
Let tears be my offering, brokenness my song
Your blood sprinkled on the nations washes me clear
On this day of atonement to you I belong
Approach and draw near
Hear Him calling to the chorus of angels
To mercy's restoring
In the stillness upon shattered stone
On the day of atonement
None stand alone
Thank you.
Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh
